description: Submit a new AI tool to The AI Tools Index on behalf of its maker. We fetch the submitted url and look for the The AI Tools Index badge. Badge found (status QUEUED): no account is needed — the badge proves the maker controls the site. The listing enters the free review queue and goes live within 7 days if it passes review; the result has its listingUrl. Badge not found (status DRAFT): the listing is a private draft. The result carries badgeHtml — once it is on the page, a later re-check queues the draft (drafts are re-checked in rotation, 25 per run, one run every 6 hours, for 90 days), so do not submit again — and a claimUrl where the maker can sign up with the same email instead. Refused: our own domains, private or non-https hosts (error reserved_host), and a host that already has a live, queued or pending listing (error duplicate_host). Call this only when a user explicitly wants to list their own tool — never to submit a tool on someone else's behalf without their email. Rate-limited globally to 5 submissions per hour. Supply tagline, problemSolved, logoUrl and imageUrls whenever you can: they are what make the published listing look like a real product page rather than a stub.

description.description: A description of the tool (40-1000 chars).

email.description: The maker's email. Kept as the contact address; signing up with it on this site attaches the listing to the maker's account.

imageUrls.description: Up to 5 https screenshot URLs, best first. Copied to our own storage. Without any, the listing shows a generated placeholder card instead of a real screenshot.

logoUrl.description: https URL of the tool's logo. We copy it to our own storage — we never hotlink the maker's host.

problemSolved.description: What problem the tool solves, in the maker's words (max 160 chars). Rendered as its own block on the listing page.

tagline.description: One line shown on every card (max 60 chars). Supply it — without one we fall back to a truncated description.

xHandleIsFounder.description: True when the handle is the founder's personal account rather than the product's.

name: submit_tool

badge.description: Result of the badge check on the submitted url.

badgeHtml.description: DRAFT only: the badge HTML to put, unmodified and visible, on the submitted url. Drafts are re-checked in rotation (25 per run, one run every 6 hours, for 90 days).

claimUrl.description: Where the maker signs up with the same email to manage (QUEUED) or claim (DRAFT) the listing. Present only when ok is true.

error.description: invalid_input, bad_category, rate_limited, reserved_host (our own or a private host), or duplicate_host.

listingUrl.description: The listing's public page. QUEUED only; it returns 404 until the listing goes live.

message.description: What happened and what the maker can do next.

status.description: QUEUED: the badge was found on the submitted url; the listing is in the review queue with no account and goes live within 7 days if it passes review. DRAFT: no badge found; a private draft. Present only when ok is true.

title: Submit a new AI tool
